# Create plot of incubation vOTU abundance in environmental samples through time
```{r}
#file.choose()
library(dplyr)
votu_abundance <- read.csv("/Users/isabelledanforth/K_brevis_viromes/output/abundance/incubation_votu_abundance.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(votu, sample, collection_date, abundance_pct, family, breadth)

# REMOVE VOTU19 (IQ-TREE analysis shows it is not a member of the Pandoravirales)
votu_abundance <- votu_abundance %>%
  filter(votu != "vOTU19")

# comvert collection_date into a date
library(readr); library(ggplot2); library(lubridate)
class(votu_abundance$collection_date)
votu_abundance <- votu_abundance %>%
  mutate(collection_date = ymd(collection_date))

# fix names of the families assigned to each vOTU
votu_abundance <- votu_abundance %>%
  mutate(family = case_when(
    family == "unclassified" ~ "Unclassified",
    family == "IM_01"        ~ "Imitervirales family 01",
    family == "IM_14"        ~ "Imitervirales family 14",
    family == "IM_16"        ~ "Imitervirales family 16",
    .default = family
  ))

votu_colors <- c(
  # Imitervirales family 01
  vOTU03 = "#003366",  
  vOTU06 = "#0066cc",  
  vOTU07 = "#3399ff",  
  vOTU13 = "#99ccff", 
  # Unclassified
  vOTU02 = "#993300",  
  vOTU09 = "#cc6633",  
  vOTU12 = "#ff9966",  
  vOTU17 = "#ff3300",  
  # Imitervirales family 16
  vOTU08 = "#660033", 
  vOTU18 = "#cc3366", 
  # Imitervirales family 14
  vOTU11 = "#330066"  
)


votu_abundance_plot <- ggplot(votu_abundance, aes(collection_date, abundance_pct, colour = votu, group = votu)) +
  facet_wrap(~family, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = unique(votu_abundance$collection_date),
    date_labels = "%b %Y"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Relative abundance (% of sample reads)", title = "vOTU abundance in environmental samples through time") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = votu_colors) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.05),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 50, hjust = 1),   # 2. angled
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    title = element_text(size = 30)
  )
votu_abundance_plot
ggsave("votu_abundance.png", votu_abundance_plot, dpi = 300, width = 15, height = 9.00, units = "in")

```


# Plot of cell abundance through time 
```{r}
#file.choose()
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
cell_ct <- read.csv("/Users/isabelledanforth/Downloads/ycag051_supplementary_material/SupplementalData14.csv", skip = 5) %>%
 clean_names() %>%
 dplyr::select(cruise, station, k_brevis, total_diatoms, total_other) %>%
 slice(c(1:9, 11:12)) %>%
 mutate(
    # Extracts "1220" and converts it to "2020-12-01" (Date class)
    date = my(str_extract(cruise, "\\d{4}"))
  )

# convert counts into numbers (currently characters)
library(readr)
cell_ct <- cell_ct %>%
  mutate(across(c(k_brevis, total_diatoms, total_other), parse_number))

# convert into tidy format
library(tidyr)

cell_ct_long <- cell_ct %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(k_brevis, total_diatoms, total_other),
    names_to = "phyto_group",
    values_to = "cell_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_count = parse_number(as.character(cell_count)),  # handles "13,333" stored as text
    date = as.Date(date)
  )

# prelim plot
cell_counts <- ggplot(data = cell_ct_long, mapping = aes(x = date, y = cell_count, color = phyto_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = unique(cell_ct_long$date),
    date_labels = "%b %Y"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(k_brevis      = "goldenrod1",   # 3. your colors
               total_diatoms = "springgreen3",
               total_other   = "lightgrey"),
    labels = c(k_brevis      = expression(italic("Karenia brevis")),   # 1. your labels
               total_diatoms = "Diatoms",
               total_other   = "Other protists")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Cell count", title = "Abundance of protist taxa") +
  theme_classic() +                         # complete theme FIRST
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.9),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 30, hjust = 1),   # 2. angled
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    title = element_text(size = 30)
  )
cell_counts
ggsave("cell_counts.png", cell_counts, dpi = 300, width = 15, height = 9.00, units = "in")

```


# Some kind of linear regression (cell count ~ vOTU abundance -- each vOTU?)
```{r}
# we now want to add cell count data to the votu abundance table 
cell_ct_long <- cell_ct_long %>%
  rename(collection_date = date)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# One row per date, one column per phyto group
cell_wide <- cell_ct_long %>%
  select(collection_date, phyto_group, cell_count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = phyto_group, values_from = cell_count) %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(collection_date, "month")) %>%
  select(-collection_date)

# Add the cell counts to each vOTU row by sampling month
votu_cells <- votu_abundance %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(collection_date, "month")) %>%
  left_join(cell_wide, by = "month") %>%
  select(-month)

# test it out with votu2
votu_cells_votu13 <- votu_cells %>%
  filter(votu == "vOTU13")

library(scales)

kb <- cell_ct_long %>%
  filter(phyto_group == "k_brevis") %>%
  mutate(cell_count_plot = pmax(cell_count, 1))   # log scale can't show 0, so floor at 1 cell

# Scaling factor: puts the K. brevis peak at the height of the highest vOTU value
f <- max(votu_abundance$abundance_pct) / max(kb$cell_count)

library(scales)

votu_abundance$votu <- factor(votu_abundance$votu, levels = c("vOTU03", "vOTU06", "vOTU07", "vOTU13",
                                                "vOTU02", "vOTU09", "vOTU12", "vOTU17",
                                                "vOTU08", "vOTU18", "vOTU11"))

votu_plot <- ggplot(votu_abundance, aes(collection_date, abundance_pct)) +
  # K. brevis drawn first so it sits behind the vOTUs
  geom_line(data = kb, aes(y = cell_count_plot * f),
            colour = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = kb, aes(y = cell_count_plot * f),
             colour = "grey40", shape = 17, size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = votu, group = votu), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = votu), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~family, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Collection date", y = NULL, title = "vOTU abundance in environmental samples through time") +
  scale_y_log10(
    name = "Relative abundance (% of sample reads)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / f, name = expression(italic("K. brevis")~"(cells/L)"),
                        labels = label_comma())
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = votu_colors) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = unique(votu_abundance$collection_date), date_labels = "%b %Y") + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = votu_colors) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 3)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.05),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, angle = 50, hjust = 1),   # 2. angled
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    title = element_text(size = 30)
  )
  
ggsave("votu_cells.png", votu_plot, dpi = 300, width = 15, height = 9.00, units = "in")


# Now lets see if we can fit a linear model 
# maybe look only at Imitervirales family 16 vOTUs
# Imitervirales family 14 vOTUs
# Pandoravirales family 05 vOTUs

votu_cells_IM16 <- votu_cells %>%
  filter(family == "Imitervirales family 16")
votu_cells_IM14 <- votu_cells %>%
  filter(family == "Imitervirales family 14")

lm_IM16 <- lm(k_brevis ~ abundance_pct, data = votu_cells_IM16)
summary(lm_IM16)

lm_IM14 <- lm(k_brevis ~ abundance_pct, data = votu_cells_IM14)
summary(lm_IM14)

lm_PV05 <- lm(k_brevis ~ abundance_pct, data = votu_cells_PV05)
summary(lm_PV05)

lm3_full <- lm(k_brevis ~ abundance_pct*family*collection_date, data = votu_cells)
summary(lm3_full)
```
